_note: The model is built on the STANDALONE company (Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd = the lead-acid business plus some lithium trading and lubes), which is how the street values the core (MOFSL, Nuvama, Anand Rathi, 360 ONE, ICICI Direct, Avendus all use standalone FY28E EPS). The lithium-ion subsidiary Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies (ARACT: packs, the cell giga-factory, the BESS plant), the lead recycler Amara Raja Circular Solutions (ARCSPL) and Amara Raja Power Systems (ARPSL) sit outside the standalone accounts: 'groupDrag' = consolidated net profit less standalone net profit. Consolidated segments (Ind AS 108, from FY24): 'Lead acid batteries and allied products' and 'New energy business' (lithium packs, chargers). History: the New Energy business was moved from the standalone company to ARACT by slump sale on 1-Jun-2023 (Rs223.96 cr, AR FY24 note 22); the plastic-components business of Mangal Industries was demerged into the company with appointed date 1-Apr-2022 (NCLT order 10-Jan-2024; FY23 restated in AR FY24; Screener keeps FY23 as first reported).
